name: lookup_events
description: Read-only CloudTrail management event history in China Regions. For IAM/global events also query cn-north-1 (Beijing); a Ningxia-only empty result is insufficient. Automatically follows pages within 24 seconds / max_pages (default 24). For deletion or IAM/policy investigations use event_names, e.g. [DeleteBucket,DeleteRole,PutBucketPolicy,AttachRolePolicy,PutRolePolicy], instead of broad user enumeration. Each event name is queried separately (CloudTrail allows one LookupAttribute). Check complete, queries[].complete/next_token/query_params and output_truncated. Never infer no changes from an incomplete query. Routine AgentCore service AssumeRole/CreateLogStream noise is counted and hidden by default; human/unfamiliar AssumeRole remains. Use include_noise for authentication investigations. This covers management events, not S3 object/data events or other Regions. Continuation must preserve the exact original time range and attribute filter.

region.description: China Region: cn-northwest-1 (default) or cn-north-1. IAM/global-service audits must also check Beijing.

event_names.description: 1-16 specific EventNames. Do not combine with attribute_key/value or next_token.

include_noise.description: Include routine AgentCore service authentication/logging events; defaults false.

max_events.description: Maximum returned events 1-200; defaults 100. Omitted count remains explicit.
